reasons: The finding is properly classified as 'missing': the rationale confirms the only occurrence of 'insurance' is in the fees clause (charges payable by Licensee), which imposes no coverage obligation on Licensor, and the General Provisions (p0145–p0159) contain no insurance subsection.

The redline is a clean, minimal insertion of a new subsection (l) at the end of the General Provisions list, immediately following (k), preserving existing text verbatim and following the rule's redline guidance to add a short insurance paragraph in the miscellaneous section.

Inserted limits track the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for processing of Licensee data, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request) and are correctly directed at Licensor as the vendor.

The comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the required prefix, explains the rationale (Licensor hosts the platform and handles trade data/Confidential Information) and offers the playbook fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and an insurance obligation is present in the output.
